South Loop Weekend Ride (Ray Hubbard Loop)

Dallas, TX · Little Forest Hills · Road

South Loop Weekend Ride (Ray Hubbard Loop) is a road group ride in Dallas, TX. It rolls saturdays and Sundays at 7:30 am from Corner of St. Francis Ave and Forest Hills Blvd. About 50+ miles, 20+ mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 20+ mph. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the South Loop Weekend Ride (Ray Hubbard Loop) group ride

The long-running fast ride out of East Dallas. It heads east to Mesquite and Sunnyvale along Lake Ray Hubbard and back. About 50 miles at 20 mph or more and it is a drop ride with no leader, so know the route. A steadier Sunday 8:00 am group does a shorter no-drop version at 17 to 20 mph.
